description: Defines the external frame buffer interface for the AOM (Alliance for Open Media) video codec library, including structures, callback prototypes, and constants related to frame buffer management.

methods.name: aom_get_frame_buffer_cb_fn_t
methods.description: Callback prototype for retrieving a frame buffer, allocating memory, and initializing the buffer.

methods.name: aom_release_frame_buffer_cb_fn_t
methods.description: Callback prototype for releasing a frame buffer when it is no longer referenced.
